mapper.select: select (select count(*) from study_plan where user_id = #{userId} and is_template = 0 and date(create_time) = curdate()) as plan_count, (select coalesce(sum(tomato_duration), 0) from tomato_record where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 and start_time >= CURDATE() and start_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) as study_minutes, (select count(*) from tomato_record where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 and start_time >= CURDATE() and start_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) as tomato_count, (select count(*) from study_plan where user_id = #{userId} and status = '1' and date(completed_time) = curdate()) as completed_tasks

select coalesce(sp.subject, '未分类') as subjectName, coalesce(sum(tr.tomato_duration), 0) as totalMinutes from tomato_record tr left join study_plan sp on tr.plan_id = sp.plan_id where tr.user_id = #{userId} and tr.status = 1
and tr.start_time >= #{startDate}
and tr.start_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
group by sp.subject having totalMinutes > 0 order by totalMinutes desc
